card.line: The Sea of Galilee, also called the Sea of Tiberias, is a lake where Jesus called fishermen to follow Him, healed many people, and met His disciples.

moments.title: Fishers of Men
moments.text: Jesus walked beside the sea and saw fishermen casting nets and mending them. He called Peter, Andrew, James, and John, and they left their nets and boat and followed Him.

moments.title: Healing Along the Shore
moments.text: Jesus went along the Sea of Galilee and up on a mountain. Large crowds laid the lame, blind, crippled, and mute at His feet, and He healed them.

moments.title: A Deaf Man Hears
moments.text: Jesus came to the Sea of Galilee, and people brought a deaf man who could hardly speak. Jesus opened his ears and freed his tongue, and the people were amazed.

moments.title: Crowd Near the Sea
moments.text: Jesus crossed the Sea of Galilee, and a large crowd followed Him because of the signs He did for the sick. He asked Philip where to buy bread for them.

moments.title: Jesus Appears at Dawn
moments.text: After a night of catching nothing, the disciples met Jesus on the shore. At His word they cast the net on the right side and caught so many fish they could not haul it in.
